Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection

Class Protections

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.Protections
public final class Protections extends Object
The permission checks a vanilla bucket applies before it changes the world, applied to the context's actor: the real player or a dispenser's automation player. Unowned automation has no actor and is always permitted.

The block-use packet path gates on Level.mayInteract(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos) before an item ever sees it, so this exists for the operations driven from Item.use, which the server receives without a target position, and for automation.

      Applies vanilla's spawn-protection, world-border, and block-placement gates to an edit of the world at pos: fluid or block placement and removal, cauldron and block-storage transfers, and entity or item release.
      Parameters:
      level - level the action applies in
      context - acting player and hand, dispenser, or unowned automation
      pos - exact block position the action changes
      face - face associated with the action
      stack - bucket stack driving the action
      Returns:
      true when the actor may modify pos

    • mayInteract

      public static boolean mayInteract(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, ProtectionContext context, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos)
      Applies vanilla's spawn-protection and world-border gate to an interaction with an entity at pos. The block-placement gate is skipped, since interacting with a mob neither places nor breaks a block.
      Parameters:
      level - level the action applies in
      context - acting player and hand, dispenser, or unowned automation
      pos - position of the target entity
      Returns:
      true when the actor may interact at pos
